House style: moderate Bokmål with three genders (ei/-a for feminine nouns, en/-en masculine, et/-et neuter), weak past in -et, neuter definite plural in -ene, sju and tjue, "ble", "ga". "Gud tilgir synd" echoes the seed story story-01. Marta speaks of prayer as speaking with God.

sentences.text: Hver søndag går Marta i kirka. Hun ber, og hun takker Gud.
sentences.english: Every Sunday Marta goes to church. She prays, and she thanks God.

sentences.text: Gud er god. Jeg takker Gud hver dag.
sentences.english: God is good. I thank God every day.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Hva ber du om, Marta?
sentences.english: What do you pray about, Marta?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Jeg ber om håp for alle folk. Jeg ber om det hver dag.
sentences.english: I pray for hope for all people. I pray for it every day.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Takk, Marta! Hva er en bønn?
sentences.english: Thank you, Marta! What is a prayer?
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: En bønn er å snakke med Gud. Du kan be hver dag.
sentences.english: A prayer is talking with God. You can pray every day.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Du kan takke Gud. Du kan be for Anna, Lars og Nils.
sentences.english: You can thank God. You can pray for Anna, Lars and Nils.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Jeg har synd i hjertet, Marta.
sentences.english: I have sin in my heart, Marta.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Alle folk har det. Det er en bønn. Gud tilgir deg.
sentences.english: All people do. That is a prayer. God forgives you.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Jeg vet at Gud tilgir synd. Jeg vil be om det.
sentences.english: I know that God forgives sin. I want to ask for it.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Det er bra. Gud elsker deg, Sam. Det er håp.
sentences.english: That is good. God loves you, Sam. There is hope.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Sam ber hjemme i rommet. Han sier: «Gud, tilgi synden min.»
sentences.english: Sam prays at home in his room. He says: "God, forgive my sin."

sentences.text: «Takk, Gud. Takk for Marta, Anna, Lars og Nils.»
sentences.english: "Thank you, God. Thank you for Marta, Anna, Lars and Nils."

sentences.text: «Du elsker meg. Jeg har håp.»
sentences.english: "You love me. I have hope."

sentences.text: Sam er glad. Han har fred i hjertet. Det er en god bønn.
sentences.english: Sam is happy. He has peace in his heart. It is a good prayer.

sentences.text: Det er søndag. Sam og Marta drikker kaffe etter kirka.
sentences.english: It is Sunday. Sam and Marta drink coffee after church.

sentences.text: Nils kommer til dem. Han er sulten.
sentences.english: Nils comes to them. He is hungry.

sentences.text: Hva gjør du i kirka, Marta?
sentences.english: What do you do in church, Marta?
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Vi sang, og vi ba. Presten leste i bibelen.
sentences.english: We sang, and we prayed. The pastor read in the Bible.
sentences.speaker: marta

sentences.text: Jeg liker sangen. Men jeg liker ikke å sitte.
sentences.english: I like the song. But I do not like sitting.
sentences.speaker: nico

sentences.text: Jeg liker å sitte. Jeg liker sangen også.
sentences.english: I like sitting. I like the song too.
sentences.speaker: sam

sentences.text: Marta trenger smør og egg. Hun handler i butikken, og listen er lang.
sentences.english: Marta needs butter and eggs. She shops at the shop, and the list is long.

sentences.text: Sam står opp før Anna. Han gjør lekser tidlig, og om natten sover han godt.
sentences.english: Sam gets up before Anna. He does homework early, and at night he sleeps well.

sentences.text: Sam tenker på turen til fjellet. Veien var lang, og fjellet var høyt.
sentences.english: Sam thinks about the walk to the mountain. The road was long, and the mountain was high.

sentences.text: Lars har vondt i hodet. Legen sier at han må hvile.
sentences.english: Lars has a headache. The doctor says that he has to rest.

sentences.text: Nils mistet ikke jakka på turen.
sentences.english: Nils did not lose his jacket on the walk.
